tasks.title: Notification repository layer
tasks.description: Create NotificationRepository: getNotifications (with type filter + pagination), getNotificationContexts, markAsRead (batch), markAllAsRead, archiveNotifications (batch), archiveAll, getUnreadCount.
acceptanceCriteria: getNotifications({ type: 'mention' }) returns only mention notifications
markAsRead([id1, id2]) sends batch update and returns per-ID result
getUnreadCount handles network error by returning cached count

tasks.title: Notification TanStack Query hooks
tasks.description: Query: useNotifications (infinite), useUnreadCount (polls 30s). Mutations: useMarkAsRead, useArchiveNotifications, useMarkAllAsRead, useArchiveAll. Optimistic updates. Syncs count to Zustand.
acceptanceCriteria: useMarkAsRead optimistically sets isViewed true in cache
useUnreadCount polls every 30s and syncs to useInboxStore.unreadTotal
Archive mutation removes items from visible list immediately

tasks.title: Inbox Zustand store
tasks.description: Create useInboxStore: unreadTotal (tab badge), activeFilter, selectedIds (Set for bulk). Actions: setUnreadTotal, setFilter, toggleSelected, selectAll, clearSelection.
acceptanceCriteria: setFilter('mentions') updates activeFilter and triggers re-render
toggleSelected adds if absent, removes if present
clearSelection empties set and exits bulk mode

tasks.title: Inbox route group
tasks.description: Create inbox/ route group with Stack navigator. Tab entry and badge already handled by tracker phase's tab shell (which reads useInboxStore.unreadTotal when the store exists).
acceptanceCriteria: Inbox route group has Stack navigator with headerShown false
Tab navigation between Inbox and other tabs preserves each stack's navigation state

tasks.title: Notification list screen
tasks.description: FlashList notifications sorted newest-first. NotificationRow: type icon, title, body preview, timestamp, unread dot. Filter chips. Swipe-to-archive. Bulk actions header. Pull-to-refresh. Empty state per filter.
acceptanceCriteria: Swipe left reveals archive action; completing swipe removes from list
Filter chips are mutually exclusive; switching re-fetches
Empty state shows different message per filter

tasks.title: Notification detail / deep navigation
tasks.description: notificationRouter maps objectClass to deep link. Marks as read on navigate. Fallback detail screen for unknown types. Handles deleted source docs.
acceptanceCriteria: Tracker issue notification navigates to /tracker/issue/[id]
Unknown objectClass shows fallback detail instead of crash
Deleted source doc shows 'no longer available' with back action

tasks.title: Bulk operations
tasks.description: BulkActionBar: Mark as read, Archive buttons with count. Long-press enters selection mode. Select all header. Batch mutations. Haptic feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-press enters selection; subsequent taps toggle without navigation
Mark as read (N) processes all selected then exits selection
Partial batch failure keeps unprocessed items selected with error toast
